row.evidence: Runway's Enterprise SSO FAQ says: "Does Runway Enterprise SSO support SCIM (System for Cross-domain Identity Management)? At this time, no. We do not support SCIM."
row.notes: Status changed from gated to none: Runway's own SSO FAQ says it does not support SCIM (or SAML); June's 'SCIM bundled with Enterprise' had no first-party source and is dropped. SSO is OIDC-only on Enterprise (Contact sales), with JIT registration on SSO sign-in. Pricing moved to runway.com: Standard $12, Pro $28, Max $76 per month billed annually ($15/$35/$95 monthly) are single-user plans; the new Team plan ($55/seat/mo annual, $69 monthly, 2-9 seats) is the first multi-user tier, so team_plan moved from Standard to Team. Runway's developer API covers generation plus an Enterprise audit-log API for linked workspaces; no user-management endpoints.

limitations.text: Runway states it does not support SCIM; Enterprise SSO is OIDC-only with JIT registration.

auth.notes: Bearer API key from the developer portal; audit-log endpoints need an account link to the workspace.

Get a single audit log entry

limitations.text: The developer API is for generative models, usage and audit logs; no user, member or role endpoints are listed.

okta.notes: Runway's guide uses a custom OIDC app in Okta; no OIN listing found (okta.com/integrations/runway/ returned 404).

entra.notes: Custom OIDC app registration in Entra; no gallery tutorial found.

google.notes: FAQ lists Google among OIDC-capable IdPs; no Google-specific guide.
